sentences.en: Statutory law is written and passed by a legislature.
sentences.zh: 成文法是由立法机关制定并通过的。

sentences.en: Her father was accused of statutory rape.
sentences.zh: 她父亲被指控犯有法定强奸罪。

sentences.en: There are no statutory minimum paid vacations or paid public holidays in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国没有法定最低带薪年假或带薪公共假日。

senses.zh: 法定的，法令的,依照法令的,可依法处罚的
